title: Cover Flow
description: Records from the top songs on a black floor with their reflections. Drag, fling, scroll, scrub or use the arrow keys and the covers swing past on a speed-capped spring, a gloss sliding across each sleeve as it turns to the light. Every sleeve is spaced by its projected width, so no two ever cross or overlap, at any width or mid-swing. Click the record in the middle, or press Enter, and it flips over to its back with the tracklist, printed on the sleeve's own colour; its neighbours step aside to make room, and it turns back as you move on.
intent: The classic browser with the one move the iPod had and the web versions forgot: the centred record flips to its back. One spring per cover for the flip, one speed-capped spring for the flow, and one light that both share.
